name: Grok Bot
description: Grok Bot, Cursor's always-on cloud agent: its week's allowance and when it renews, its value estimated at list prices by day and model, and its latest conversations. Read from Cursor's dashboard with Cursor.app's sign-in on this machine, once you allow it; nothing saved.
author: Vaultite

account.label: Read Grok Bot's usage from your Cursor account
account.description: with Cursor.app's sign-in on this machine, Grok Bot's week and what each of its requests was worth are read from cursor.com every few minutes (one read with the Cursor plugin's); the sign-in goes only to Cursor and nothing is kept. Off until you allow it
